rename.to: Error "ngModule should be provided" when ViewContainerRef.createComponent is called

body: Have some solutions if I have only factory and ViewContanerRef in component?
So where did this `ComponentFactory` come from? From a `ComponentFactoryResolver`? Or is it directly imported from a `.ngfactory.ts` file / from a call to `Compiler.compile`?

A workaround is as follows:

1. call `const compRef = componentFactory.create(..., viewContainerRef.injector.get(NgModuleRef))`
2. call `viewContainerRef.insert(compRef.hostView)`

issue.title: fix(core): provide `NgModuleRef` in `ViewContainerRef.createComponent`.

issue.body:
This is needed to support the corner cases:
- usage of a `ComponentFactory` that was created on the fly via `Compiler`
- overwriting of the `NgModuleRef` that is associated to a 
  `ComponentFactory` by the `ComponentFactoryResolver` from
  which it was read.

Fixes #15241
